recommendations: Optimize title length (currently 25 chars, ideal is 30-60).
Optimize site assets to lower load time (currently 4.39s).
Optimize server response time and eliminate render-blocking elements.

friction_points: No prominent Call-to-Action (CTA) visible above the fold.
Few trust badges, security statements, or satisfaction guarantees.
recommendations: Place a clear, high-contrast CTA button in the hero section above the fold (e.g., 'Book a Call', 'Get Started').
Incorporate trust badges, SSL icons, or satisfaction statements near forms to reassure prospects.
Establish a social media presence (e.g., LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).

summary: An executive review was performed on Nike's web operations and marketing readiness. The site utilizes a tech stack consisting of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel. We identified a solid technical framework with minor adjustments needed. Addressing these core metrics can increase visitor conversion and lead intake.

strengths: Structured search metadata, including descriptive title and header configurations.
High-converting call-to-actions and direct booking/interaction channels.
Strong social proof backed by visible client reviews and testimonials.
weaknesses: High page load latency, which increases visitor bounce rates.
Inconsistent social presence or missing high-value profile networks.
opportunities: Compress heavy images and optimize server script load order to increase mobile performance.
Establish a branded presence on missing social channels to capture local traffic.

outreach.email:
Subject: Quick growth audit for Nike

Hi Nike Team,

I recently ran a quick performance and conversion audit on https://nike.com. We also noticed you don't have active links to social media platforms in your main menu, which is a great way to build client trust.

I saw that Nike positions itself around: "Nike - Official Online Store for Athletic Shoes, Clothing & Sports Gear. Shop the latest Nike products and enjoy free shipping."

I noticed your primary website action is 'Air Force 1', so I focused the audit on reducing friction around that path. 

You have a great foundation, but I noticed a couple of technical adjustments that are likely costing you leads and sales:

- Mobile Performance: The website takes around 4.4 seconds to fully load, which is likely causing mobile visitors to bounce before they contact you.

These are relatively straightforward adjustments that can increase your conversion rates by 15-30%.

I've put together a 10-minute video showing exactly how to fix these gaps. Would it be alright if I sent that video over? No strings attached.

If this is not relevant, reply "not interested" and I will not follow up.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Info]
